prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion Path", "Select how you would like to build or pick your desktop companion today.", "Select Path", "Adopt Pre-made Pet vs Generate Custom Pet"]
1: ["Design Your Companion's Desktop Habitat", "Pick a cozy starter environment for your desktop pet before formal adoption.", "Habitat Style", "Cozy Room, Cyber Lounge, Minimal Desk", "Confirm Habitat", "Continue to Adoption Certificate"]
2: ["Your Companion is Arriving Soon!", "Play with desktop toys while your high-resolution pet assets are generated.", "Click desktop items to interact with your pet while waiting."]
3: []
4: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion in Under 2 Minutes", "A quick setup unlocks an interactive, customizable virtual pet right on your computer desktop."]
5: ["Ensure bright, even lighting and direct front-facing photos for optimal 3D desktop rendering.", "Lighting Tip", "Avoid dark or side-lit photos for realistic output"]
6: ["Your Companion is Now Live on Your Desktop!", "Use these quick shortcuts to interact, move, or hide your pet anytime.", "Desktop Controls Quick Reference", "Drag to move • Right-click for menu • Shift+Click to minimize"]
7: ["Downloading high-definition desktop textures and animation sequences..."]
8: ["Founder Perk Unlocked", "Free Starter Accessory Pack included with adoption"]
9: ["Arrival Alert", "Desktop Status Check", "Companion verified active on primary screen"]
